name: Arnis (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over yellow in the proportions 1:2, charged at the centre with the city arms of Arnis (a sailing ship on yellow beneath tools on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Arnis; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Arnis arms — sailing ship and tools
